units.source_text: 虽然盼望昭雪，但念身经流放，

en.t: Although I hope my innocence will be cleared, when I think that I have suffered exile,

units.source_text: 虽古之贤人，亦难照旧与人为伍；

en.t: even a sage of old would find it hard to live among others as before;

units.source_text: 我是何人，岂敢妄想再见京华？”宰相答道：

en.t: who am I, that I should dare to dream of seeing the capital again? The Counselor replied:
